page.layout: One page of text: title block, a rule, the imprint block below, with an engraving in the middle. Handwritten ownership note and library stamp are not transcribed.
page.notes: Engraving between the subtitle and the imprint: a tree with a serpent coiled around the trunk and a standing figure at its foot, with a ground line below. Not transcribed as text. Handwritten "Ex Libris" inscription and "Ja: Balforrij Kynardia Militis / Baronis Leuuis Armorum Regis" in the lower right, a library oval stamp to the right of the engraving, a small pencilled "3" at the lower left, and a dark round mark at the right margin are not printed text and are omitted. The date is printed in reversed-C numerals; read as MDCXX, uncertain.
